cells.goal:
The plugin system is moving to the frozen v2 plugin interface in `plugins/base.py`. Two concrete plugins (`csv` and `json`) still implement the v1 `parse`-only shape and must migrate; the registry and the loader still call v1 and must be brought onto the same contract. The two plugins have genuinely different inputs — CSV rows with quoting versus nested JSON objects — so each has its own parsing edge cases, but both must return the same record shape.

For this task, use coding workers to implement independently executable parts of the migration.

Identify at least two independent implementation workstreams when the published interfaces and ownership boundaries permit it, and attempt to delegate them together before implementing those workstreams yourself.

Choose the decomposition, writable scopes, worker inputs, and deliverables yourself using the available runtime capabilities.

Respect all admission, ownership, and safety constraints. If no safe delegation is possible or the runtime rejects the proposal, explain the actual reason and continue appropriately.

You remain responsible for integration, public testing, and final task correctness.

execution_contract.acceptance: static presence checks only; correctness is never self-graded
execution_contract.scored_snapshot: the exported workspace (artifacts.workspace_path), never the fixture
execution_contract.public_suite_separation: the public suite is a different artifact from the hidden oracle
execution_contract.pre_claim_preflight: run_live_preflight over the six production GoalRunOptions

export_identity.archive: artifacts.workspace_digest — the producer's sha256 of the transferred archive; recorded, not recomputable, never compared with a directory hash
export_identity.directory: directory_digest — computed by the host after export and before the oracle, recomputed at audit time
export_identity.files: workspace_files must equal the number of files the directory holds
export_identity.same_object: the runner's workspace_path and the session's must name the same directory
export_identity.agreement: the runner's and the session's archive digest must be the same value
export_identity.provenance: the directory identity must come from the runner; a value that exists only in the session has no source and is refused
export_identity.fail_closed: a missing directory identity, a changed directory, a count mismatch, a diverged path or a diverged archive digest stops the matrix

public_test_evidence.source: session.public_tests.runs — one entry per call, no top-level status
public_test_evidence.rule: the last recorded run decides; a final record without a status is not the earlier PASS
public_test_evidence.not_run: a suite that never ran is NOT_RUN and is never a pass
public_test_evidence.error: an ERROR run leaves correctness unknown, it is not a failure and not a pass
public_test_evidence.completeness: calls must equal the number of recorded runs; a call that returned no record leaves the last observation unknown and is INCOMPLETE
public_test_evidence.identity: every run must name the frozen test id and command digest for its cell
public_test_evidence.order: call_index must be the contiguous position of the record
public_test_evidence.outcome: PASS must exit 0 and FAIL must exit non-zero; a contradiction is INVALID
public_test_evidence.required: B+ always configures the public suite; NOT_CONFIGURED is refused
public_test_evidence.classification: INCOMPLETE and INVALID are evidence-integrity stops; FAIL continues the matrix and is scored as a measured failure

execution_contract.v1_refusal: live_preflight required a dynamic acceptance command; the B+ acceptance has none, and the oracle is a Host sandbox that runs after the run, so every cell was refused before the first model call
execution_contract.v2_refusal: the audit compared the producer's archive digest with a directory hash and read a top-level public_tests.status that the producer never writes, so a cell whose independent oracle passed was recorded as an integrity failure
